{{Quote|Aggaba, I want to hire you and your people.''"<br />"''Which ones?''"<br />"''All of you. You're temporarily the head of these men, until you reach Bandomeer. I'll buy out your contracts.|Clat'Ha to Aggaba before reaching Bandomeer|<ref name="The Rising Force" />}}
'''Aggaba''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] assistant who worked for [[Jemba]] of the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]]. During a flight to [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] on the [[Monument (freighter)|''Monument'']], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] shot down the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and left Aggaba and the ship's other occupants temporarily stranded on an unknown [[Planet/Legends|world]]. After Jemba was accidentally shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Hutt [[Grelb]] during a battle against [[draigon]]s, [[Clat'Ha]] offered Aggaba twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for every miner's contract, as well as an additional twenty thousand credits as a signing bonus for joining Clat'Ha and the [[Arcona Mineral Harvest Corporation]]. Aggaba accepted the deal, and several other Offworld miners left the mining corporation as well.<ref name="The Rising Force" />
